install: Include apps/delta/cyclorama.gitconfig in ~/.gitconfig and set features = cyclorama-dawn
installSteps: Install the matching `.tmTheme` files from `apps/bat/` and run `bat cache --build` so `syntax-theme` resolves cleanly.
author: Real-Fruit-Snacks

themes.name: Cyclorama Dawn
themes.tagline: Dark git-delta diff palette with Signal Emerald additions, Signal Crimson deletions, and Beacon Orange file headers.
themes.copySnippet:
[delta "cyclorama-dawn"]
    dark = true
    light = false
    syntax-theme = Cyclorama Dawn
    plus-style = syntax "#0D291E"
    plus-non-emph-style = syntax "#0D291E"
    plus-emph-style = syntax "#1A5B40"
    plus-empty-line-marker-style = normal "#0D291E"
    minus-style = syntax "#301218"
    minus-non-emph-style = syntax "#301218"
    minus-emph-style = syntax "#6E2831"
    minus-empty-line-marker-style = normal "#301218"
    zero-style = syntax
    line-numbers = true
    line-numbers-left-style = "#8C8F9D"
    line-numbers-right-style = "#8C8F9D"
    line-numbers-minus-style = "#FF5C6C"
    line-numbers-plus-style = "#3DDC97"
    line-numbers-zero-style = "#8C8F9D"
    file-style = bold "#FF9254"
    file-decoration-style = "#62646D" ul
    file-added-label = [added]
    file-copied-label = [copied]
    file-modified-label = [modified]
    file-removed-label = [removed]
    file-renamed-label = [renamed]
    hunk-header-style = file line-number syntax
    hunk-header-decoration-style = "#2A2C35" box
    hunk-header-file-style = bold "#74B8E8"
    hunk-header-line-number-style = bold "#FF9254"
    whitespace-error-style = reverse "#FF5C6C"
    blame-palette = "#050507 #0C0C10 #14141A #1C1D26 #112436"
    merge-conflict-begin-symbol = ~
    merge-conflict-end-symbol = ~
    merge-conflict-ours-diff-header-style = bold "#74B8E8"
    merge-conflict-ours-diff-header-decoration-style = "#2A2C35" box
    merge-conflict-theirs-diff-header-style = bold "#FF9254"
    merge-conflict-theirs-diff-header-decoration-style = "#2A2C35" box
